case.title: Review of Emergency Water Purification Kit Procurement and Distribution - Monsoon Response 2026
case.description: A synthetic administrative review into quantity reconciliation, stock recording and beneficiary distribution of 480 emergency water purification kits ordered during a fictional monsoon response.

પરંતુ સ્થાનિક લાભાર્થી યાદીમાં માત્ર 240 પરિવારોના નામ છે. વોર્ડ 4 માં 60 કિટ આપવામાં આવી હોવાનું જણાવવામાં આવ્યું છે. વોર્ડ 5 માં 18-08-2026 સુધી કોઈ કિટ મળી નથી.
वितरण सारांश में 18-08-2026 तक कुल 330 किट जारी दर्शाई गई हैं: वार्ड 3 में 250 और वार्ड 4 में 80।
भौतिक सत्यापन के समय भंडार में 24 किट उपलब्ध पाई गईं। भंडार कर्मचारी ने बताया कि 18-08-2026 को 6 किट नमूना और परीक्षण हेतु जारी की गई थीं।
निरीक्षण के समय मूल हस्ताक्षरित आपूर्ति चालान उपलब्ध नहीं कराया गया।
मैंने 16-08-2026 की शाम को एक जल शुद्धिकरण किट प्राप्त की। किट देने वाले व्यक्ति ने किसी सूची पर हस्ताक्षर कराए। मुझे कुल वितरण संख्या की जानकारी नहीं है।
मुझे 17-08-2026 की सुबह एक किट मिली। वितरण के समय वाहन वहाँ नहीं था; किट स्थानीय केंद्र से दी गई थी।
मेरे परिवार को 16-08-2026 को किट नहीं मिली। 17-08-2026 को भी केंद्र पर नाम खोजने पर सूची में नाम नहीं मिला।

contradictions.explanation: The stock register records 480 kits received on 15 August at 14:00. The gate register records only 360 unloaded on 16 August at 17:30 and 120 departing with the vehicle at 19:10. The stock-register entry lists challan number 88, corresponding to the gate register reference BRL/NDV/88. These entries require reconciliation; the gate record may not capture an earlier or separate movement.

The work order and supplier invoice each refer to 480 kits, while the gate record shows 360 unloaded and 120 returned to the vendor depot. The delivery challan is not available in the inspection record.

The complaint reports 300 kits in Ward 3 and 60 in Ward 4 (360 total), while the inspection memo reports 250 in Ward 3 and 80 in Ward 4 (330 total), both stated as of 18 August. Source registers and beneficiary lists are needed to determine which figures are supported.

The complaint states that the register reportedly shows 300 Ward 3 kits while the local beneficiary list contains only 240 household names. This is an internal mismatch reported by the complainant and requires the underlying list and register page.

contradictions.category: Recorded stock balance versus physical count
contradictions.explanation: The stock register shows a closing balance of 144 kits on 18 August, while the inspection memo reports 24 kits physically present on 19 August. The 120-kit difference may relate to the quantity recorded as returned to the vendor depot in the gate log, but the stock adjustment and return receipt are not included.

The gate register records 360 kits unloaded on 16 August 2026.
The final beneficiary distribution total by 18 August 2026 was 360 kits.
A signed supplier delivery challan confirming full receipt of 480 kits is available in the inspection file.

sections.heading: Executive Summary
sections.text: This synthetic case concerns a work order for 480 water purification kits valued at INR 600,000. The available records contain inconsistent quantity and timing information. The work order and invoice state 480 kits; a stock-register image records 480 kits on 15 August; the gate register records 360 unloaded and 120 returned on 16 August. The inspection memo records 24 units physically present, 6 sample units issued and 330 units distributed by 18 August. These figures require reconciliation before any administrative conclusion.

sections.heading: Documents Reviewed
sections.text: Seven synthetic documents: Gujarati complaint, Hindi inspection memo, English work order, Gujarati stock register, English gate movement register, Hindi beneficiary statements and English supplier invoice.

sections.heading: Key Issues
sections.text: Receipt quantity and timing; invoice quantity compared with gate movement; distribution total differences; Ward 3 beneficiary list discrepancy; absence of the original signed delivery challan in the inspection file.

sections.heading: Limitations
sections.text: All records are invented for software testing. The original supplier challan, complete beneficiary registers, payment voucher, store issue slips and vendor depot receipt are not included. No conclusion about wrongdoing or liability can be drawn.

sections.heading: Recommended Verification Steps
sections.text: Obtain the original signed delivery challan, vendor dispatch register, vehicle trip sheet, receiving officer statement, full Ward 3 and Ward 4 beneficiary registers, sample issue voucher and payment file. Compare timestamps, quantities and signatures.
